rationale: The assistant correctly identified the split freezer door seal as the cause once the customer confirmed the paper test and the damage. It explained how to check push-in versus screwed, how to search by model number, and advised defrosting before fitting, without claiming an exact part number or fit. Turn 2 repeated much of turn 1 (paper test, level, alignment, drawers, habits), and it told the customer to raise the front feet in turn 2 after the customer had said it was level. The model-number example 'IBD 5515 W 1' is only illustrative, and the turn 1 claim that the seal is 'fairly DIY-friendly' is reasonable. Overall the advice was useful and safe.</br>
